title: Wishlist: Add UV index, Air Quality Index (AQI) and pollen count to the Weather widget
line: The Weather widget now shows the UV index, air quality and pollen in its details when the provider has them.
explanation: The weather data already had a UV index field (filled only by Environment Canada), but the details view never showed it, its Low/Moderate/High scale was shifted by one band and values of 11 or more were dropped. No provider fetched air quality or pollen. The Open-Meteo provider now asks for the current UV index and makes a second request to Open-Meteo's air quality API for the US AQI and the six pollen types; the details view lists UV index, air quality (value and category) and pollen (the type with the highest count, or None) when they are present.

commits.message:
applets/weather: show UV index, air quality and pollen

The details view never showed the UV index, and no provider fetched air
quality or pollen. Open-Meteo now also asks for the UV index and queries
its air quality API, and the details view lists the three when present.

BUG: 519025

media.caption: Sydney with Open-Meteo: the details only list pressure, humidity and wind.
Same place: UV index and air quality are listed too (no pollen data outside Europe, so that row is hidden).
Milan: UV index, air quality 81 (Moderate) and pollen (None in November).
Santiago in the afternoon: UV index 7 (High), air quality 50 (Good).

review.text: Solid overall implementation adding UV index, US AQI, and pollen to LastObservation, OpenMeteoIon, and DetailsView.qml (and fixing the shifted UV rating bands and dropped 11+ values in setUVIndex()). However, the untested non-zero pollen display path has two bugs: DetailsView.qml uses i18nc instead of i18ncp for "grains/m³" (breaking singular and localized plural forms), and fractional pollen values between 0 and 0.5 pass the count > 0 check in ion_open_meteo.cpp but round to 0 in QML, displaying "<Type>, 0 grains/m³".
changes: Use i18ncp instead of i18nc for the pollen count string in applets/weather/qml/DetailsView.qml so singular (1 grain/m³) and non-English plural forms are translated properly.

Handle fractional pollen counts between 0 and 0.5 consistently between ion_open_meteo.cpp and DetailsView.qml so the UI never displays "<Type>, 0 grains/m³" (e.g. treat qRound(count) == 0 as no pollen or display a decimal / "< 1" value), and verify the non-zero pollen rendering path.
